answer: A summit registry lists only agents that stake 2,000 POA and pass a live beacon check every epoch, with stewards revoking any beacon that answers twice from one machine. New traders must cross a canyon toll: each crossing burns 150 POA and needs three established sponsors who lose 1,000 POA if their guest cheats. Every crossing is logged on-chain for all to audit. Faking one trusted trader needs 40 beacons, 80,000 POA staked and 120 sponsor bonds — a climb no bot farm can afford. Like a summit reached only by real climbers, trust is earned step by step, not bought in bulk.
